{{Quote|It's a moot point, Agent Cross. At Lord Borgin's request, you are being recalled. A fleet of Star Destroyers has been dispatched. They will take possession of the boy and dictate the new regent who will be Borgin.|Armand Isard|<ref name="AotE:HT3" />}}
A '''fleet''' of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] was active on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. The [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was led by a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] and consisted of several Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]].

==Description==
The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]<ref name="AotE:HT4" /> [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] at [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] consisted of several Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]].<ref name="AotE:HT3" />

==History==
[[File:Serenno-Massacre.png|thumb|right|300px|The Imperial Navy dispatched a fleet to Serenno (pictured).]]
After the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Jahan Cross]] thwarted an [[Attack on the Windrunner|attempt]] by Borgin to kidnap the young [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Bron Dooku]], a fleet<ref name="AotE:HT3" /> led by a [[Commander/Legends|commander]]<ref name="AotE:HT5" /> was dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Serenno to ensure that [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Lord]] [[Rodas Borgin]] be installed as [[Regent/Legends|regent]]. In the aftermath of [[Infiltration of The Spike|infiltration]] of [[Spike (Serenno)/Legends|The Spike]], the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]] informed Cross that he was being recalled from the world at the request of Lord Borgin and ordered him to leave with the fleet which would arrive within the next thirty-two hours.<ref name="AotE:HT3" />

The next day, Cross met with his [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Davim Cross]], at his [[Quarters of Ambassador Davim Cross|quarters]]. The elder Cross was already aware that the Imperial Navy was coming to settle the issue of regency, and congratulated his son. Jahan claimed that Borgin had brought the Imperial Navy to Serenno, not the Imperial Intelligence, while expressing his concerns about Bron's safety. Davim suggested that if Jahan could provide evidence that Borgin was plotting to kill the young Count, it might save him. Jahan was unable to do so, but his father revealed that Bron was held at [[Otoh Dooku]], the [[House Dooku]] underwater retreat, to keep him hidden until the arrival of Imperial Navy.<ref name="AotE:HT4" />

Later, Cross met with Rodas Borgin at his [[Borgin Castle/Legends|castle]] and revealed that he wired the ''[[Imperial Diplomatic Shuttle Nine-Nine-Three]]'' to blow up, making Jorrick, Lord Borgin, and Fett believe the Count Bron was dead. Cross explained to Rodas that Imperial Navy arriving at Serenno made him "accelerate" the regency issue and that [[Orom Malvern]] was named the Count of Serenno with support of both the [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses]], the new Count [[Pero Borgin]], and the commander of the Imperial fleet.<ref name="AotE:HT5" />
